Blest is the man whose bowels move
Blest is the man whose bowels move,
And melt with pity to the poor,
Watts made this hymn from Psalm 41:1–3, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1Blessed is the one who cares for the poor; the LORD will deliver him in the day of trouble. 2The LORD will protect and preserve him; He will bless him in the land and refuse to surrender him to the will of his foes. 3The LORD will sustain him on his bed of illness and restore him from his bed of sickness. PSALM 41:1–3 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 41
Blest is the man whose bowels move, And melt with pity to the poor, Whose soul, by sympathising love, Feels what his fellow-saints endure. STANZA I
